reviews.comment:
Taught of PowerPoint only. Would ask difficult questions from a slide like, "what are we looking at?" then 5 people would answer incorrectly, and then it would go silent... then he would give the answer... and it wouldn't even be a term we learned in class. 

He's smart and sometimes funny, but's he's tired of teaching and it shows.

terrible prof. He's very smart, and very personable, so you really want to like him. but, the class makes it hard to. ppts were borderline incoherent, and had information that was wrong. Expectations were unclear both before and after every project. Test averages would be failing and he would blame us. NO communication. would rate 0/5 if I could.

This class was a little different than the standard format of lectures and exams and is not impossible for anyone to learn in, and personally it was more engaging. Make sure to read over the PowerPoints before campfires and have a few questions down. Dr. Giardino does care about his students, he's a bit old school but overall a great guy.

This was genuinely one of the most stressful classes I have taken since gen chem. There are no lectures, just PowerPoints. We met once a week and discuss the PowerPoints. He makes you learn from mistakes, rather than giving guidance. The ENTIRE course load was group work. He is an old school teacher who loves make learning as hard as possible.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: dr. gs sense of humor is kind of cruel. he gets off on making people feel stupid or embarrassed. he doesnt lecture. we had to read chunks and you discuss in campfire (labs). he WILL call on you many times. company project grading is unclear & never good enough. VERY group work heavy. i only got through this class bc of my cool group members <3
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: AWFUL!! Please if you can avoid him do NOT take him. He is one of those professors that get off on failing and intimidating students. He is not helpful, condescending, and sometimes very creepy. Literal embodiment of hey boomer RUN! I got an A in his 105 class and could barely pass his 420 class for reference.

He has an interesting sense of humor that will go over your head if you don't catch it. He tries to make students laugh a little and he has very cool stories. I really liked his teaching style but it's not for everyone so be cautious, you have to work hard to succeed in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He uploads around 10 PPTS a week and expects you to teach yourself, then come to "campfire" (lab) each week with questions that he never fully answers. All labs are group work but they only make half sense, and everything is done through EMAIL. Not sure what was up with that. I couldn't learn anything and dropped, do your research before taking him

I heard he was a great professor before moving online so I'm sad to say this is the worst class I've ever taken. He doesn't lecture, just uploads PPTs. You have a chance to ask questions once a week but chances are he won't actually answer it. Assignments and due dates are so confusing (everything is through email) and he won't help you.

Imagine reading a textbook but it being 20x worse. That's what you have to do every week because this prof will not lecture. We learn on our own in chunks. He holds "campfires" where you meet up in small groups to talk about the material in the chunks, but just calls out people constantly and tries to get answers out of people that no one knows...

I didnt really love Giardinos teaching style, I feel that he was sometimes unclear on instructions and hes a really hard grader. He made us teach ourselves the content outside of class and that wasnt effective at all for me but he did ask for feedback and at the end, he curved our grade significantly. Hes a very nice professor but Im iffy.
He has been my favorite professor at A&M. He divides the huge class into small groups just so he can talk to us more closely. Very thoughtful

If I could put caring, hilarious, inspirational and every other description word I would. Dr. G, is an experienced professor who wants you to learn. He gives you the basics and makes you use and apply what he has taught you in projects in "companies". He is always there for you if you need help or someone to talk to. A very caring and great prof.
